description: The conversion events send_conversion_event stored for this brand, newest first, with each one’s delivery per platform (sent, failed or skipped, and why). action list (default) filters by from / to (YYYY-MM-DD), eventName, source, platform, deliveryStatus (sent | failed), fromAd and campaignId, paged with cursor; action get takes eventId; update sets a stored event’s value (and currency) for journeys, LTV and profit; retract removes it from Hermoso’s records. Identifiers are stored hashed and never returned; test and validate-only sends are never stored. Free.

action.description: default list (get when eventId is given)

eventName.description: filter, or which copy of an eventId

fromAd.description: only events from an ad click (true) or not (false)

name: conversion_events
title: Stored conversion events
